title: Permissible areal organic loading as a function of ambient temperature

symbols.definition: design organic load in kg BOD₅/ha/d and
average temperature during coldest month of the year in degree Celsius.

applicability: Second design approach for permissible areal organic loading of facultative ponds, based on field experience in warm climates, relating the loading to ambient temperature on the assumption that temperature depends on solar radiation.
notes: The printed definition of Lo ends with a stray "and"; preserved.
The subscript of Lo is printed as a lower-case o (Lo) while the same symbol appears as L0 elsewhere in the chapter.
